spec.description: Provider operations for Nais Postgres (CNPG): one, several or all tenant datasources, with separate repeated sections and reported CPU/memory/PVC sums. Observed primaries, replication, Barman backups, WAL and storage; not complete inventory, end-to-end availability or a restore guarantee.

panels.title: Selected fleet footprint — 8 configured tenant sources

panels.description: Reported sums for the selected environments/teams/Postgres/branches, including replicas and inactive branches. CPU is cores; memory/storage are GiB. CPU/memory capacity means positive container limits, not node allocation; PVC capacity is actual kubelet filesystem capacity, requested is separate. Each discovered pgdata PVC counts once. Compare sample counts with observed pods/PVCs: fewer samples means a partial sum, not a complete footprint. Missing values are Unknown, not zero. Missing pod/PVC discovery is outside this inventory. Excludes poolers, operators, backup objects, network and logging. The overall table queries the explicit 8 configured tenant sources; repeated tenant sections discover datasources dynamically.
